scripts.retention:cleanup: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml run --rm --no-deps api pnpm exec ts-node src/database/monitoring-retention.ts
scripts.migration:show: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml run --rm --no-deps api pnpm exec typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:show -d src/database/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:run: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml run --rm --no-deps api pnpm exec typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:run -d src/database/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml run --rm --no-deps api pnpm exec typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:revert -d src/database/data-source.ts
scripts.production:migration:show: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml run --rm --no-deps api node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.production:migration:run: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml run --rm --no-deps api node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.production:migration:revert: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml run --rm --no-deps api node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
